name: TikTok 视频下载
description: 下载一个 TikTok 视频为 MP4 文件（页面内拉流落盘到浏览器下载目录）。需要浏览器可访问 TikTok；受限视频返回结构化错误。

body.name: js

args.expression: (async()=>{const want=(p)=>{p=(p||'').trim();return (!p||p[0]==='$')?'':p;};const target=want('$url');const isTik=()=>/tiktok\.com\/.+\/video\//.test(location.href);if(target&&location.href!==target&&!isTik()){location.href=target;const t0=Date.now();while(Date.now()-t0<20000&&!isTik())await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));}if(!isTik())return {ok:false,error:'not-video-page',hint:'请传入 TikTok 视频链接（tiktok.com/@user/video/<id>）'};await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,3000));const ud=document.getElementById('__UNIVERSAL_DATA_FOR_REHYDRATION__');if(!ud)return {ok:false,error:'no-data',hint:'页面数据未渲染（可能需要登录或视频受限）'};const j=JSON.parse(ud.textContent);const detail=(j['__DEFAULT_SCOPE__']||{})['webapp.video-detail']||{};const vi=detail.itemInfo&&detail.itemInfo.itemStruct;if(!vi)return {ok:false,error:'restricted',statusCode:detail.statusCode||null,hint:'视频受限（如官方账号区域限制/私密视频）或需要登录'};const v=vi.video||{};const bi=(v.bitrateInfo||[]).sort((a,b)=>(b.Bitrate||0)-(a.Bitrate||0))[0];const playUrl=(bi&&bi.PlayAddr&&bi.PlayAddr.UrlList[0])||v.playAddr;if(!playUrl)return {ok:false,error:'no-play-url'};const t0=Date.now();const blob=await fetch(playUrl,{credentials:'include'}).then(r=>{if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);return r.blob();});const author=((vi.author||{}).uniqueId)||'tiktok';const desc=(vi.desc||'').replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g,'_').trim().slice(0,60)||'tiktok';const filename=author+'_'+desc+'.mp4';const objUrl=URL.createObjectURL(blob);const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=objUrl;a.download=filename;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();setTimeout(()=>{a.remove();URL.revokeObjectURL(objUrl);},120000);return {ok:true,downloaded:true,filename:filename,sizeMB:Math.round(blob.size/1048576*10)/10,durationSec:v.duration,author:author,desc:(vi.desc||'').slice(0,60),url:location.href};})()

body.note: 读 rehydration 数据 → 最高码率 playAddr → 页面内拉流 → 锚点另存
